comment.body:
Thanks for the report. We can see this is on Windows 10 with `PowerToysUserSetup-0.101.2432.0-x64` from GitHub, that double-clicking PowerToys does not open Settings, and that the same action works on your Windows 11 laptop. We also found your earlier report #43620, where DISM/SFC were clean and older logs showed a Settings crash, but the diagnostic ZIP for this current report appears to have failed to upload.

Could you reproduce the problem on the Windows 10 machine and then comment `/bugreport` immediately afterward so a fresh diagnostic ZIP is attached? If the upload fails again, please paste the Windows Event Viewer > Windows Logs > Application error for `PowerToys.Settings.exe` from the same reproduction, especially the faulting module name and exception code.
